description: This file defines a class for indexing HTML content fields within OrchardCore CMS, including the index data structure and provider logic for indexing HTML fields in content items.

classes.name: HtmlFieldIndex
classes.description: Data structure for indexing HTML fields, inheriting from ContentFieldIndex, containing a string property 'Html'.

classes.name: HtmlFieldIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for HTML fields in content items, implementing Describe method to map content items to index entries.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are mapped to index entries for HTML fields, including filtering, lazy loading of content definitions, and extracting HTML content.
